factual_claims.source_evidence: Group consolidated statement of cash flow: 'Cash flow from investing activities: -351.2 (-204.0)' and Management Report: 'The most significant investments during the year include the new automation solution in the central warehouse, the opening of two new stores...'

factual_claims.claim: The company financed its investment cycle through new borrowings of SEK 270.3 million, bringing total interest-bearing liabilities to SEK 1,416.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Group consolidated statement of cash flow: 'New loans: 270.3 (175.6)' and Note 28: 'Total financial liabilities: 1,416.3 (1,169.3)'

factual_claims.claim: Net debt excluding lease liabilities stood at SEK 292.5 million, down from SEK 333.1 million, while the equity ratio declined to 14.8 percent from 20.3 percent due to balance sheet expansion and increased borrowing.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Position section: 'Net debt (+) / Net cash (-), excluding IFRS 16: 292.5 (333.1)' and 'Equity ratio of 14.8 (20.3) %'

factual_claims.claim: The reporting period was defined by large-scale infrastructure investments and retail format innovation.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'To meet the increased growth, operations at the central warehouse in Vansbro continue to expand... In recent years, Lyko has also developed a new store concept and retail format – FABStore...'

factual_claims.claim: Lyko advanced the ramp-up of a fully automated warehouse in Vansbro, expanding daily processing capacity to approximately 100,000 orders to support long-term scalability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Vansbro Warehouse section: 'The new automation... handles both e-commerce orders and store replenishment, with a capacity of up to approximately 100,000 orders per day!'

factual_claims.claim: The retailer debuted its standardized Fab Store concept in Täby Centrum and extended its physical footprint with new locations in Norway and Finland, bringing the total number of stores to 34.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Selected Events: 'In October, the store in Westfield Täby Centrum in northern Stockholm reopened as Lyko’s first Fab Store'... 'In 2025, Lyko continued its expansion in Finland by opening its third store in Espoo'... 'At the end of 2025, the total number of stores in the group is 34 (32)'

factual_claims.claim: The company continued building its own brands portfolio, including the relaunch of Make Up Store and the introduction of PLY Skin and Scandinavian Soap Factory.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Own Brands section: 'In 2025, Make Up Store was relaunched'... 'During the year, PLY Skin was also launched'... 'The new own brand Scandinavian Soap Factory was launched in spring.'

factual_claims.claim: In Europe, a segment reorganization began, closing local offices in Germany and the Netherlands to centralize operations and lower overhead.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Significant Events: 'A reorganization of the Europe segment was initiated, including the closure of local offices in the Netherlands and Germany. Operations in these markets will going forward be managed centrally from the Nordic headquarters...'

factual_claims.claim: Management highlighted that despite intensified sector competition and widespread profit warnings elsewhere in the beauty industry, Lyko maintained above-market growth and reinforced brand awareness.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Statement: 'In an industry marked by profit warnings, intense competition and structural shifts, we continued to grow, gain market share, and strengthen our position as the leading beauty destination in the Nordics'... 'We see that we are top of mind among consumers in several markets...'

factual_claims.claim: Following the reporting date, the board announced a SEK 100 million annual cost savings program and secured a three-year extension of revolving credit facilities, signaling a strategic shift toward stabilizing profitability while preserving execution capacity for continued expansion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events after the end of the year: 'In January... Lyko published a Trading Update with preliminary figures and announced a cost savings programme. The programme is expected to generate annual cost savings of approximately SEK 100m... On March 31, Lyko signed an extension agreement with Danske Bank and Swedbank to extend current RCFs until 2028.'

numerical_claims.claim: Lyko Group reported net revenue of SEK 3,962.6 million for the full year 2025, an 11.3 percent increase from SEK 3,561.7 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The group’s net sales amounted to SEK 3,962.6m (3,561.7), representing a growth of 11.3% compared to 2024.'

numerical_claims.claim: Growth was concentrated in the Nordics segment, where sales rose 12.0 percent to SEK 3,699.8 million, representing 93.4 percent of total group revenue.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net Sales and Results per Segment table & Management Report: 'Nordics: Net sales 3,699.8 (3,304.3)... At the end of 2025, Lyko Nordics accounted for 93.4 percent of sales.'

numerical_claims.claim: European online sales decreased 1.3 percent to SEK 130.7 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Net Sales and Results per Segment table & Management Report: 'Europe: Net sales 130.7 (132.4)... Europe remains a smaller portion of net revenue, totaling SEK 130.7 million in 2025, a decrease of 1.3 percent compared to the prior year.'

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit reached SEK 1,658.7 million, though the gross profit margin contracted to 41.9 percent from 44.0 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table: 'Gross profit 1,658.7 (1,568.8)... Gross profit margin, % 41.9 (44.0)'

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit (EBIT) declined to SEK 78.2 million with a 2.0 percent margin, down from SEK 117.4 million and a 3.3 percent margin in 2024.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: SEK 78.2 million (2025) / 2.0% margin (2025) / SEK 117.4 million (2024) / 3.3% margin (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 78.2 million (2025) / 2.0% margin (2025) / SEK 117.4 million (2024) / 3.3% margin (2024)

numerical_claims.claim: Depreciation and amortization increased to SEK 174.1 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 10: 'Depreciation and amortization of non-current assets: 174.1 (170.0)'

numerical_claims.claim: Higher net financial expenses, combined with operating results, led to a pre-tax loss of SEK 0.9 million compared to a pre-tax profit of SEK 37.6 million previously.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'EBIT for the period amounted to SEK 78.2m (117.4)... Financial expenses -82.7... Profit (+) / Loss (-) before tax -0.9 (37.6)'

numerical_claims.claim: The group recorded a net loss of SEK 3.0 million, translating to earnings per share of negative SEK 0.20, versus a net profit of SEK 21.0 million and earnings per share of SEK 1.37 in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Group consolidated statement of comprehensive income: 'Profit / Loss for the year: -3.0 (21.0)' and Note 14: 'Earnings per share (SEK) before/after dilution: -0.20 (1.37)'

numerical_claims.claim: Despite reduced profitability indicators, cash flow from operating activities improved substantially to SEK 527.5 million from SEK 209.7 million, driven by strong increases in operating liabilities.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Group consolidated statement of cash flow: 'Cash flow from operating activities: 527.5 (209.7)' and Management Report: 'Cash flow from operating activities for the full year amounted to SEK 527.5m (209.7)... Cash flow from working capital changes... Change in operating liabilities 533.8 (39.3)'
